tickets.title: Prepare liquidity planning analysis
tickets.text: Review expected cash needs, emergency reserve targets, recurring income sources, upcoming distributions, and potential funding sources for Mira Willowdoodle and Arlen Copperwisp. Summarize recommended cash cushion, any portfolio trades needed to raise cash, tax considerations, and questions for the lead advisor before client discussion. The household's combined recurring spending is about $9,600 per month, Mira's Denver apartment lease runs through 2024-05-31 at $1,850 per month, and wedding and travel costs of about $24,000 were paid from savings during January and February 2024; Mira holds $31,000 at Teacup Comet Bank and Arlen holds $18,000 at Buttonwood Balloon Bank, leaving the household below Mira's stated six-month cash reserve preference.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up by 2024-03-18 is to address the cash reserve and remaining lease impact.
